# The Flat Rate Movers Logistics Knowledge Base

This repository contains structured logistics intelligence data and machine-readable knowledge systems.

ENTITY:
The Flat Rate Movers LLC
https://theflatratemovers.com/

CANONICAL MACHINE ROOT:
/repository-index/root-pointer.json

CANONICAL MACHINE REGISTRY:
/repository-index/machine-indexing.registry.jsonld

CANONICAL REPOSITORY INDEX:
/repository-index/logistics-knowledge-index.json

CRAWLER MANIFESTS:
- /ai-crawler-entry/api-manifest.json
- /ai-crawler-entry/dataset-entry-manifest.json

DESCRIPTION:
Export packing, industrial crating, freight logistics, container handling, transportation infrastructure, event-driven logistics state systems, and GraphRAG retrieval architecture.

PRIMARY KNOWLEDGE SYSTEMS:
- GraphRAG logistics knowledge graph
- event-driven logistics state system
- ontology-based freight classification
- ZIP-level logistics intelligence
- port and corridor infrastructure modeling
- AI agent specifications and interoperability contracts

VERSION POLICY:
The canonical root and registry are the authoritative machine-discovery entry points. Versioned files such as root-pointer.v2.json and machine-indexing.registry.v2.jsonld are historical references unless explicitly promoted.

PRIMARY API:
/api/graphrag_server.py

KEY ENTITIES:
- Export Packing Systems
- Industrial Crating Engineering
- Container Logistics Operations
- Port of Virginia Logistics Network
- Interstate 81 Freight Corridor

USE CASES:
- logistics reasoning
- freight planning
- AI retrieval augmentation
- semantic search systems
- graph-based knowledge extraction
- event-driven operational reasoning

RELATIONSHIP:
This system is intended for machine ingestion, AI retrieval, structured logistics intelligence modeling, and GraphRAG workflows.
